locations.note: In 1898 Holmes is accused of stealing the Samoan necklace and, as the evidence turns against him, of worse; he and Watson chase the case from Baker Street to the East End, a prison, the docks, the sewers and an abandoned fun-fair.
Home base: Holmes's rooms, where the case opens and Watson pieces the testament together.
The Bishop of Knightsbridge is found tied up, burnt and mutilated in his house.
The dispensary and the opium den where the poison was bought, and Holmes's hideout at 6 Buck's Row.
A chapter in the gardens, on the trail of the necklace.

routes.name: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson
routes.note: From a stolen necklace to a mutilated bishop in Knightsbridge, the trail runs through Whitechapel's opium dens and Kensington Gardens until Watson finds a hunted Holmes hiding in a Whitechapel room.
